Scan and OLO partner on browser-based Unitree robot deployment

The partnership combines hardware and AI infrastructure with browser tools for teleoperation, simulation and navigation.

OLO Robotics / RoboticsTomorrow ↗13 October 2026English editorial summary
Story

Hardware meets deployment software

Scan Computers and Sheffield-based OLO Robotics are combining Scan’s robots, AI infrastructure and technical services with OLO’s browser platform. Target applications include industrial inspection, research and prototyping.

Test before deployment

Built on ROS 2, OLO brings together teleoperation, simulation, sensor monitoring and autonomous navigation. Teams can develop and test behaviour virtually before deploying it on Unitree robots supplied by Scan, using browser-based tools.

A lower starting barrier

The partners aim to reduce the initial dependence on specialist ROS developers, not prove that every installation needs no engineering. No measured deployment times or safety results are reported. A demonstration is planned at Scan booth 3068 at GTC Berlin, October 20–22.
